stories.title: Gaming on the 4GB Radeon RX 6500 XT and GTX 1650 Super in 2026 — upscaling makes low-end GPUs viable for esports and internet cafes

sources.title: Gaming on the 4GB Radeon RX 6500 XT and GTX 1650 Super in 2026 — upscaling makes low-end GPUs viable for esports and internet cafes
sources.title_en: Gaming on the 4GB Radeon RX 6500 XT and GTX 1650 Super in 2026 — upscaling makes low-end GPUs viable for esports and internet cafes
sources.title_original: Gaming on the 4GB Radeon RX 6500 XT and GTX 1650 Super in 2026 — upscaling makes low-end GPUs viable for esports and internet cafes
sources.summary: Practically every graphics card introduced since 2022 has had at least 6GB or 8GB of VRAM, but AMD is bucking that trend in 2026 with the new RX 9050 4GB. We dusted off two older 4GB cards to see if that little VRAM means an instant performance cliff.
sources.summary_zh: 实际上，自 2022 年以来推出的每张显卡都至少配备 6GB 或 8GB VRAM，但 AMD 将在 2026 年推出新款 RX 9050 4GB，扭转这一趋势。我们清理了两张较旧的 4GB 卡上的灰尘，看看这个小 VRAM 是否意味着性能会立即悬崖。

stories.title: Ten years later, the iconic GTX 1080 Ti still holds up in 1080p gaming, but not without showing its age — Redux testing highlights the wonders of 11GB VRAM & the woes of time

sources.title: Ten years later, the iconic GTX 1080 Ti still holds up in 1080p gaming, but not without showing its age — Redux testing highlights the wonders of 11GB VRAM & the woes of time
sources.title_en: Ten years later, the iconic GTX 1080 Ti still holds up in 1080p gaming, but not without showing its age — Redux testing highlights the wonders of 11GB VRAM & the woes of time
sources.title_original: Ten years later, the iconic GTX 1080 Ti still holds up in 1080p gaming, but not without showing its age — Redux testing highlights the wonders of 11GB VRAM & the woes of time
sources.summary: PC Games Hardware has retested the GTX 1080 Ti, along with its GP102 brethren, in a range of new games across multiple resolutions. The results reveal the obvious: the 1080 Ti is still a capable GPU at 1080p, mostly thanks to its 11GB VRAM buffer, but it's highly inefficient by today's standards.
sources.summary_zh: PC Games Hardware 在一系列跨多种分辨率的新游戏中重新测试了 GTX 1080 Ti 及其 GP102 兄弟。结果揭示了显而易见的事实：1080 Ti 在 1080p 下仍然是一款功能强大的 GPU，这主要归功于其 11GB VRAM 缓冲区，但按照今天的标准来看，它的效率非常低。
